source: Public official 2026-04-09 unit damage callback, ordinary projectile and catapult rock analysis; independently implemented, no original code or art copied.

rules.shield_wall: Retains stance, including while marching; still records attacker.
rules.damage: A valid source callback can trigger even at zero final damage; no minimum damage threshold.
rules.source: Per-person attacker identity travels through melee, charge, ordinary arrow and stone area hits. Null-source ground volley and divine effects do not acquire a source.
rules.attack_move: Preserves its route; if target dies during pursuit, resumes attack-move. Target dying after attack-state entry goes idle in the reference.
rules.movement: No forced instant facing or position change; next personal movement step pursues the attacker with existing acceleration and terrain path.
rules.target_counts: A ranged victim changes its reservation in the same decision pass.

project_mapping.idle_with_target: Existing project idle/auto/attack-move with a live target and no mounted ranged behavior represents a pursuit, so is not mistaken for true reference idle.
project_mapping.moving_horse_archer: A firing target during movement does not imply pursuit; damage can interrupt it.
project_mapping.sources_removed_on_death: Project treats zero-HP source actor as removed; original frees source slot in death processing. Exact same-frame lifecycle scheduling remains different.

known_unverified: No new same-condition original runtime damage-response recording this turn; rule evidence comes from public legacy implementation analysis.
Pursuit retarget timer/countdown, explicit-focus retargeting and original dead-slot reuse remain unaligned.
Project autonomous orders, legacy morale, visual hit timing and 64x64 sprite animation remain distinct extensions.
Latest Steam and full-system equivalence not established.
